approval.comments: DOCUMENTDATE time of day: follow vwCustTrans literally

conditions.description: Only TRANSTYPE 15 rows are in scope.
conditions.preconditions: CUSTTRANS gb01 rows on non-test account C100001: RECID 1001 TRANSTYPE 15, 1002 TRANSTYPE 8, 1003 TRANSTYPE 24.
conditions.expected: The view returns exactly one row for C100001: gb01 / 1001.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-001 only TRANSTYPE 15 rows are in scope]

conditions.description: Row count per legal entity equals in-scope FO rows (TRANSTYPE 15, not test accounts).
conditions.preconditions: Test record T900001. gb01: four TRANSTYPE 15 rows (one on T900001) plus one TRANSTYPE 8 row; us01: two TRANSTYPE 15 rows.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-002 row count per legal entity matches in-scope FO rows]

conditions.description: No (legal_entity, fo_transaction_recid) pair repeats when the account matches two non-deleted contacts.
conditions.preconditions: Two non-deleted brnz_contact rows with Rics_contactno C100003 (France, Germany). Payments gb01 3001, gb01 3002, us01 3003 on C100003.
conditions.expected: Each of gb01/3001, gb01/3002, us01/3003 appears exactly once.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-003 each payment appears once when account matches two contacts]

conditions.description: Test-account payments are left out in every legal entity, even when the account also matches a non-deleted contact.
conditions.preconditions: Test record T900001; brnz_contact T900001 non-deleted. Payments gb01 4001 and us01 4002 on T900001, gb01 4003 on ACME01.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-004 test account payments are left out in every legal entity]

conditions.description: A test record with a NULL apuk_contactnumber does not exclude other payments.
conditions.preconditions: Test records T900001 and one with apuk_contactnumber NULL. Payments gb01 5001 ACME01, 5002 C100001, 5003 T900001.
conditions.expected: The view returns gb01/5001 and gb01/5002 only.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-005 test record with NULL contact number excludes nothing else]

conditions.description: A TRANSTYPE 15 row with null account number, amounts, currency, dates and payment mode is carried through, not dropped (design: nulls carried as recorded).
conditions.preconditions: Test record T900001; a non-deleted brnz_contact with Rics_contactno NULL. Payment gb01 6001 with ACCOUNTNUM, AMOUNTCUR, AMOUNTMST, CURRENCYCODE, PAYMMODE, DOCUMENTDATE, TRANSDATE all NULL.
conditions.expected: One row: gb01, 6001, account_number NULL, contact_number NULL, is_corporate 1, payment_date/year/month NULL, both amounts NULL, currency_code NULL, payment_method_code 'Unknown', payment_method 'Unknown', country/region/market 'Unknown'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-006 row with null optional values is carried through]

conditions.description: A cancelled payment is kept.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-015: cancelled payments are not removed. Payments gb01 7001 CANCELLEDPAYMENT 1 AMOUNTMST -40.00, 7002 CANCELLEDPAYMENT 0 AMOUNTMST -60.00.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-007 cancelled payment is kept]

conditions.description: Two identical payments with different RECIDs are both kept (no de-duplication).
conditions.preconditions: gb01 8001 and 8002 on C100001, -50.00 GBP, PAYMMODE DD, TRANSDATE 2024-02-01.
conditions.expected: Two rows, 8001 and 8002, each 50.000000 / 50.000000, payment_date 2024-02-01, code DD.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-008 identical payments with different RECIDs are both kept]

conditions.description: Payments from gb01 and us01 and an old (2012) payment all appear.
conditions.preconditions: gb01 9001 TRANSDATE 2024-05-01; us01 9002 TRANSDATE 2024-05-01; gb01 9003 DOCUMENTDATE and TRANSDATE 2012-03-01.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-009 all legal entities and old dates are included]

conditions.description: EUR payment shows sign-reversed currency and GBP amounts.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-014: AMOUNTMST is GBP. Payment 10001 AMOUNTCUR -100.00 EUR, AMOUNTMST -85.00.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-010 EUR payment shows positive currency and GBP amounts]

conditions.description: Amounts keep FO's six decimal places with no rounding; zero stays zero.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-023: FO precision kept (decimal(32,6)), as recorded at sign-off. Payments 11001 AMOUNTCUR -12.345678 / AMOUNTMST -10.123457; 11002 0.000000 / 0.000000; 11003 -0.000001 / -0.000001.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-011 amounts keep six decimal places without rounding]

conditions.description: A refund shows negative and nets off against a payment on the same account.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-015: refunds are TRANSTYPE 15 with the opposite sign. ACME01 gb01: 12001 AMOUNTCUR +30.00 / AMOUNTMST +30.00 GBP; 12002 -100.00 / -100.00 GBP.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-012 refund shows negative and nets off against payment]

conditions.description: GBP payment shows positive amounts.
conditions.preconditions: Payment 13001 AMOUNTCUR -250.00, AMOUNTMST -250.00, GBP.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-013 GBP payment shows positive amounts]

conditions.description: Payment method is named from CUSTPAYMMODETABLE for the same legal entity.
conditions.preconditions: CUSTPAYMMODETABLE gb01/DD 'Direct Debit'. Payment gb01 14001 PAYMMODE DD.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-014 payment method named from the legal entity mode table]

conditions.description: Null, empty and space-only PAYMMODE give 'Unknown' for code and name, even if the mode table has a row with an empty code.
conditions.preconditions: CUSTPAYMMODETABLE gb01 PAYMMODE '' NAME 'Blank mode'. Payments gb01 15001 PAYMMODE NULL, 15002 '', 15003 '   '.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-015 null empty or blank payment mode shows Unknown]

conditions.description: A mode with no row for its legal entity, a blank NAME or a NULL NAME shows the code as the name.
conditions.preconditions: CUSTPAYMMODETABLE us01/XYZ 'Other', gb01/CHQ NAME '  ', gb01/BAC NAME NULL. Payments gb01 16001 XYZ, 16002 CHQ, 16003 BAC.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-016 unmatched or unnamed payment mode shows its code]

conditions.description: The same mode code named differently per legal entity gives each payment its own entity's name, once.
conditions.preconditions: CUSTPAYMMODETABLE gb01/DD 'Direct Debit', us01/DD 'ACH Debit'. Payments gb01 17001 DD, us01 17002 DD.
conditions.expected: Exactly two rows: gb01/17001 'Direct Debit', us01/17002 'ACH Debit'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-017 payment method name depends on legal entity]

conditions.description: DOCUMENTDATE before the cutoff is the payment date.
conditions.preconditions: Payment 18001 DOCUMENTDATE 2021-08-20, TRANSDATE 2021-09-02.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-018 document date before cutoff is used]

conditions.description: DOCUMENTDATE on the cutoff date 2021-08-23 is used.
conditions.preconditions: Payment 19001 DOCUMENTDATE 2021-08-23 (midnight), TRANSDATE 2021-09-01. Untested: a DOCUMENTDATE on 2021-08-23 with a time of day, where the rule's wording and the vwCustTrans expression disagree; asked of the owner, no answer yet.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-019 document date on cutoff date is used]

conditions.description: DOCUMENTDATE after the cutoff gives TRANSDATE.
conditions.preconditions: Payment 20001 DOCUMENTDATE 2021-08-24, TRANSDATE 2021-08-30.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-020 document date after cutoff uses transaction date]

conditions.description: DOCUMENTDATE 1900-01-01 or NULL gives TRANSDATE.
conditions.preconditions: Payments 21001 DOCUMENTDATE 1900-01-01 / TRANSDATE 2020-05-05; 21002 DOCUMENTDATE NULL / TRANSDATE 2019-12-31.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-021 year 1900 or null document date uses transaction date]

conditions.description: Any DOCUMENTDATE in year 1900 (not just 1 January) is ignored; 1901-01-01 is a real date and used.
conditions.preconditions: Payments 22001 DOCUMENTDATE 1900-12-31 / TRANSDATE 2018-07-15; 22002 DOCUMENTDATE 1901-01-01 / TRANSDATE 2018-07-16.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-022 any 1900 document date is ignored but 1901 is used]

conditions.description: Year and month are the calendar values of the payment date, not a fiscal period.
conditions.preconditions: Payment 23001 DOCUMENTDATE 2024-03-28, TRANSDATE 2024-03-31.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-023 year and month are calendar values of payment date]

conditions.description: Payment on an account matching a non-deleted contact is a contact payment.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100001 _is_deleted 0. Payment gb01 24001 on C100001.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-024 payment on a current contact account is a contact payment]

conditions.description: Payment on an unmatched, non-test account is one unsplit corporate payment.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100001 only. Payment gb01 25001 on ACME01 AMOUNTMST -1200.00.
conditions.expected: One row: is_corporate 1, contact_number NULL, account_number 'ACME01', amount_paid_gbp 1200.000000.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-025 unmatched account is one unsplit corporate payment]

conditions.description: Account matching only a deleted contact is corporate, and the deleted contact's country is not used.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100002 _is_deleted 1, country France. Payment gb01 26001 on C100002.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-026 account matching only a deleted contact is corporate]

conditions.description: When an account matches a deleted contact (lower ContactId, France) and a non-deleted contact (Germany), only the non-deleted one counts.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100004: ContactId ...0271 deleted France; ContactId ...0272 non-deleted Germany. Payment gb01 27001 on C100004.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-027 deleted duplicate contact is ignored for attribution and country]

conditions.description: Contact matching is not limited by legal entity.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100001 non-deleted. Payment us01 28001 on C100001.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-028 contact match applies in any legal entity]

conditions.description: Per legal entity, contact plus corporate GBP totals equal the legal entity total.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100001 non-deleted. gb01: C100001 -100.00, ACME01 -1200.00, ACME02 -50.50; us01: C100001 -10.00, ACME03 -20.00 (AMOUNTMST).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-029 contact plus corporate totals equal legal entity total]

conditions.description: Contact payment shows the contact's country, region and market from dim_country.
conditions.preconditions: dim_country France/Europe/EMEA. brnz_contact C100001 non-deleted with France. Payment gb01 30001 on C100001.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-030 contact payment shows country region and market]

conditions.description: Contact with NULL rics_countryid, or one with no dim_country row, shows 'Unknown' for country, region and market.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-022: region and market also 'Unknown' (recorded at sign-off). brnz_contact C100005 rics_countryid NULL; C100006 rics_countryid not in dim_country. Payments 31001 on C100005, 31002 on C100006.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-031 contact without a known country shows Unknown]

conditions.description: Corporate payment shows 'Unknown' country, region and market.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-022: region and market also 'Unknown'. Payment gb01 32001 on ACME01, no brnz_contact rows.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-032 corporate payment shows Unknown country region and market]

conditions.description: The 'Unknown' fallbacks are exactly 'Unknown' (case and no padding), compared as bytes.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-022. Corporate payment gb01 33001 on ACME01 with PAYMMODE NULL.
conditions.expected: payment_method_code, payment_method, country_name, region_name, market_reporting_region each equal the bytes of N'Unknown' when cast to nvarchar.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-033 Unknown fallbacks have exact case and no padding]

conditions.description: Account matching two non-deleted contacts (France, Germany) gives one row with one of their countries.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100003 twice, non-deleted, France and Germany. Payment gb01 34001 on C100003.
conditions.expected: One row: is_corporate 0, contact_number 'C100003', country_name 'France' or 'Germany'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-034 shared contact number gives one row with one matching country]

conditions.description: Design rule: with several non-deleted contacts, the lowest ContactId supplies the country, so the choice is stable for all the account's payments.
conditions.preconditions: brnz_contact C100003: ContactId C0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002 France (inserted first) and C0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 Germany. Payments gb01 35001 and us01 35002 on C100003.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD001].[test TC-001-035 shared contact number uses lowest ContactId country]
